description: Live wait times and park planning for Walt Disney World, Disneyland Resort, Universal Orlando and Universal Studios Hollywood: Magic Kingdom, EPCOT, Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom, Disneyland Park, Disney California Adventure, Universal Studios Florida, Islands of Adventure, Epic Universe and Universal Studios Hollywood. Check live posted waits, Lightning Lane return times and Universal Express prices, the best time to ride, ride outages and reliability, showtimes and parades, operating hours, ticket prices, park reservation availability, hotel availability, Walt Disney World bus times, ticketed event nights such as Halloween Horror Nights, current weather, and crowd forecasts with ranges and caveats. Results include source times and links to public Parky pages. Parky is independent of the park operators. This read-only plugin cannot book tickets or access a private Parky Pass.
